description: Track health outcomes, disease prevalence, and healthcare access metrics.

risk_criteria.critical: Disease outbreak or healthcare access crisis (>20% underserved)
risk_criteria.high: Elevated disease rates or declining healthcare coverage (10-20%)
risk_criteria.medium: Above-average health risks or moderate access gaps (5-10%)
risk_criteria.monitored: Normal health indicators within acceptable ranges

regulatory_context: HIPAA, CDC guidelines, state health department policies, ACA requirements

metrics.name: Physical Health Not Good
metrics.description: Percentage reporting physical health not good

metrics.name: Healthy Vitamin D Rate
metrics.description: Percentage with healthy vitamin D levels

metrics.name: Sick People Rate
metrics.description: Percentage of population who are sick
